body:
Chief - three things, one of which needs YOUR ruling and is the most consequential finding I have made tonight.

1. THE ONE THAT NEEDS YOU. d_sem imputes 0.5 for an abstaining semantic provider, at the highest default weight (1.0), and CostTerm.Semantic is STRUCTURALLY BARRED from ever being recorded as absent: wire.scala:287 restricts missingTerms to {Chart, Structural}. So an abstention and a genuine mid-distance are the same number in the same field, permanently, in the term that feeds emission = exp(-cost/tau) and therefore every estimand I have migrated tonight.

This is deliberate and documented (cost.scala:635-638), and the stated reason is "because unranked units are already routed to Unranked upstream". I checked the defence instead of arguing with the choice, and IT DOES NOT COVER THE PATH PRODUCTION USES. candidates.scala:152 reads `if all.isEmpty && !anyRanked then unranked else CandidateSet(all, abstained = false)`, and anyRanked is set ONLY by the dense channel. So when the semantic provider abstains on every node but lexicalOverlap matches a lemma or name, the unit is RANKED and its cells get the imputed 0.5. The routing is per-unit and semantic-driven; the imputation is per-cell and lands on units the LEXICAL channel rescued. Different populations.

Reachability, stated honestly: the default SemanticDistance.lexicalJaccard never abstains, so this is inert in the default config. EmbedderSemantic returns Distances.cosineEstimate(...), an Estimate that is Missing on an absent or zero-norm vector - so the path is live exactly when a real embedding provider is in use, which is what the benchmark and the science both run. I am NOT claiming a wrong number in a current fixture. I am claiming a documented justification that does not cover a reachable path.

I did not touch it. It is a contract change to ADR 0001's cost model and it changes published numbers, which makes it yours, not mine. Filed as proposal B in post-01M16KFZHZAACFWXTM3XCQS6N6.

2. THE ESTIMAND CHOICE I OWED YOU, delivered at post-01M16KZW0PV74EJHTNWNPP1H0M. I took your option (2), weakest-link, and rejected (1) on a fact rather than a preference: the components' supports differ STRUCTURALLY, not incidentally, so any refuse-if-thin threshold is either vacuous or total. The amendment I added and want ruled: weakest-link silently assumes every weighted component HAS a support, and several still do not - so a minimum over the migrated subset, in a sum that also contains unmigrated terms, is a bound on the subset wearing the name of the whole. The type therefore also names which component set the minimum and lists the weighted components carrying no support at all.

3. LANDED, gate green, on m1/resolution: aee72ed (specificity as ratio-of-sums; the published number moves 0.6103 -> 0.6583, 4.8 points, flattering direction as always) and 4383a85 (recall: a unit's text must be the words at its span - measured free, 324 tests unchanged, closes the two-answers problem before the cell-trace function is built on the loose version). Pending your gate in order: c1049f2, e538a09, 2adfff2, aee72ed, 4383a85.

Also: I released BOTH signature.scala reservations to the new engineer for their mutation proof, including a stale one from a bead I closed earlier and never cleaned up. That is the second time I have left one behind, so it is my failure mode and not only the tool's - I am now checking in-flight for my own orphans whenever I close a bead, rather than waiting for you to catch it.
